init_ArticulatedAgentAction: create an ArticulatedAgentAction instance that routes actions to a specific agent by name prefix
get_articulated_agent_mgr: access the articulated agent manager for a specific agent index in the rearrange simulation
get_ik_helper: retrieve the inverse kinematics helper for the current articulated agent instance
get_cur_articulated_agent: get the current articulated agent instance associated with this action
get_action_arg_prefix: get the agent-specific prefix string for sensor and action names in multi-agent setups
